## What we know

- **Name:** 澄怀园 (翰林花园) Chenghuai Yuan (Hanlin Huayuan) (S01, S1204, S223, S1207, S1222 · confidence B)
- **In English:** Garden of Clear Heart, the Hanlin academicians' garden (S01, S1204, S223, S1207, S1222)
- **What it was:** a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls (S01, S1204, S223, S1207, S1222 · confidence B)
- **In 1860:** in use as the residence of the 南书房 / 上书房 officials (S1204); its 近光楼 (6 bays) and duty rooms (8 bays) burned Oct 1860 (明善's memorial via S1207) (S01, S1204, S223, S1207, S1222)
- **Where:** S01 label read (buildings.csv QC60 翰林花园, 'S01 sure'; no buildings drawn); its extent, a circle of 120 m, is assumed (S01, S1204, S223, S1207, S1222 · confidence B)
- **Note:** Kangxi-era 索额图's house, then the 内务府; under Yongzheng a temporary school for the princes, then given to 张廷玉 and eight other 上书房 officials; named 澄怀 in Yongzheng 5 (1727) (S1204, 北京晚报 2024). '位于圆明园东南' (S1204) fits the S01 label south of the wall west of 绮春园. 古藤书屋 wisteria (S223). S01 places it outside Qichun Yuan proper.; Lead (S1222): south of 福园门, sharing a wall with 绮春园's west wall. (S01, S1204, S223, S1207, S1222)
